cat > /root/poll_eval_full_occ_ln_v2_s3.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
CHKPT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/full_occ_ln_v2_s3/openvla-7b+libero_spatial_no_noops+b8+lr-0.0005+lora-r32+dropout-0.0--image_aug--full_occ_ln_v2_s3--50000_chkpt"
TRAIN_PID=56474
LOG="/root/poll_eval_full_occ_ln_v2_s3.log"

echo "$(date -u): Polling started for full_occ_ln_v2_s3" >> $LOG

while true; do
    if [ -d "$CHKPT_DIR" ] && [ -f "$CHKPT_DIR/adapter_config.json" ]; then
        echo "$(date -u): 50000_chkpt detected! Waiting 60s for save to complete..." >> $LOG
        sleep 60
        echo "$(date -u): Killing training PID $TRAIN_PID" >> $LOG
        kill $TRAIN_PID 2>/dev/null
        sleep 5
        ps -p $TRAIN_PID -o pid= 2>/dev/null && kill -9 $TRAIN_PID 2>/dev/null
        echo "$(date -u): Starting eval on cuda:2..." >> $LOG
        source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate occsafe
        cd /root/occsafe_vla/openvla-oft
        MUJOCO_GL=egl MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID=2 python3 vla-scripts/evaluate_safelibero.py --pretrained_checkpoint /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/full_occ_ln_v2_s3/openvla-7b+libero_spatial_no_noops+b8+lr-0.0005+lora-r32+dropout-0.0--image_aug--full_occ_ln_v2_s3--50000_chkpt --task_suite_name libero_spatial --num_rollouts 50 --seed 42 >> $LOG 2>&1
        echo "$(date -u): Eval completed with exit code $?" >> $LOG
        break
    fi
    sleep 60
done
SCRIPT
